description_en: Asynchronously generates the JSON configuration for a synchronization task
name: GenerateDISyncTaskConfigForCreating

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace Configuration page to obtain the workspace ID.

This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace for the current API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the Data Integration synchronization task created by using the asynchronous method. Valid values:
DI_REALTIME: real-time synchronization task
DI_SOLUTION: other types of synchronization tasks

Only the asynchronous method is supported for generating real-time synchronization tasks and other types of synchronization tasks in Data Integration
parameters.help_zh:
使用异步方式创建数据集成同步任务的任务类型。取值如下：
DI_REALTIME：表示实时同步任务。
DI_SOLUTION：表示其他同步类型的同步任务。

仅支持使用异步方式生成数据集成实时同步任务和其他同步类型的同步任务。
parameters.name: task_type
task_param

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. This parameter prevents duplicate operations caused by repeated calls
parameters.help_zh: 幂等参数。用于避免多次调用导致操作重复
parameters.name: client_token

Data.description_en: The generation result of the asynchronous thread ID

Message.description_en:
The description of the cause for the failure to generate the asynchronous thread ID.
If the asynchronous thread ID is generated, this parameter is left empty
Message.description_zh:
异步线程ID生成失败的原因描述。
如果成功生成异步线程ID，则该参数的返回值为空

ProcessId.description_en: The asynchronous thread ID. You must use this ID to call the [QueryDISyncTaskConfigProcessResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/383465.html） operation to obtain the parameters required for asynchronously generating the configuration of the Data Integration synchronization task, and then use the parameters to create the task
ProcessId.description_zh: 异步线程ID。您需要通过该ID，调用[QueryDISyncTaskConfigProcessResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/383465.html）接口获取异步生成创建数据集成同步任务需要的参数，使用该参数创建数据集成同步任务

Status.description_en:
The status of generating the asynchronous thread ID. Valid values:
success: The asynchronous thread ID is generated.
fail: The asynchronous thread ID fails to be generated. You can view the cause of the failure and troubleshoot the issue
Status.description_zh:
生成异步线程ID的结果状态。取值如下：
success：表示成功生成异步线程ID。
fail：表示异步线程ID生成失败。您可以查看失败原因，处理相关问题

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：
true：成功。
false：失败
